23: tokenized_state_machine!(
24: RwLockToks<K, V, Pred: InvariantPredicate<K, V>> {
25:     fields {
26:         #[sharding(constant)]
27:         pub k: K,
28: 
29:         #[sharding(constant)]
30:         pub pred: PhantomData<Pred>,
31: 
32:         #[sharding(variable)]
33:         pub flag_exc: bool,
34: 
35:         #[sharding(variable)]
36:         pub flag_rc: nat,
37: 
38:         #[sharding(storage_option)]
39:         pub storage: Option<V>,
40: 
41:         #[sharding(option)]
42:         pub pending_writer: Option<()>,
43: 
44:         #[sharding(option)]
45:         pub writer: Option<()>,
46: 
47:         #[sharding(multiset)]
48:         pub pending_reader: Multiset<()>,
49: 
50:         #[sharding(multiset)]
51:         pub reader: Multiset<V>,
52:     }
53: 
54:     init!{
55:         initialize_full(k: K, t: V) {
56:             require Pred::inv(k, t);
57:             init k = k;
58:             init pred = PhantomData;
59:             init flag_exc = false;
60:             init flag_rc = 0;
61:             init storage = Option::Some(t);
62:             init pending_writer = Option::None;
63:             init writer = Option::None;
64:             init pending_reader = Multiset::empty();
65:             init reader = Multiset::empty();
66:         }
67:     }
68: 
69:     #[inductive(initialize_full)]
70:     fn initialize_full_inductive(post: Self, k: K, t: V) {
71:         broadcast use group_multiset_axioms;
72:     }
73: 
74:     /// Increment the 'rc' counter, obtain a pending_reader
75:     transition!{
76:         acquire_read_start() {
77:             update flag_rc = pre.flag_rc + 1;
78:             add pending_reader += {()};
79:         }
80:     }
81: 
82:     /// Exchange the pending_reader for a reader by checking
83:     /// that the 'exc' bit is 0
84:     transition!{
85:         acquire_read_end() {
86:             require(pre.flag_exc == false);
87: 
88:             remove pending_reader -= {()};
89: 
90:             birds_eye let x: V = pre.storage->0;
91:             add reader += {x};
92: 
93:             assert Pred::inv(pre.k, x);
94:         }
95:     }
96: 
97:     /// Decrement the 'rc' counter, abandon the attempt to gain
98:     /// the 'read' lock.
99:     transition!{
100:         acquire_read_abandon() {
101:             remove pending_reader -= {()};
102:             assert(pre.flag_rc >= 1);
103:             update flag_rc = (pre.flag_rc - 1) as nat;
104:         }
105:     }
106: 
107:     /// Atomically set 'exc' bit from 'false' to 'true'
108:     /// Obtain a pending_writer
109:     transition!{
110:         acquire_exc_start() {
111:             require(pre.flag_exc == false);
112:             update flag_exc = true;
113:             add pending_writer += Some(());
114:         }
115:     }
116: 
117:     /// Finish obtaining the write lock by checking that 'rc' is 0.
118:     /// Exchange the pending_writer for a writer and withdraw the
119:     /// stored object.
120:     transition!{
121:         acquire_exc_end() {
122:             require(pre.flag_rc == 0);
123: 
124:             remove pending_writer -= Some(());
125: 
126:             add writer += Some(());
127: 
128:             birds_eye let x = pre.storage->0;
129:             withdraw storage -= Some(x);
130: 
131:             assert Pred::inv(pre.k, x);
132:         }
133:     }
134: 
135:     /// Release the write-lock. Update the 'exc' bit back to 'false'.
136:     /// Return the 'writer' and also deposit an object back into storage.
137:     transition!{
138:         release_exc(x: V) {
139:             require Pred::inv(pre.k, x);
140:             remove writer -= Some(());
141: 
142:             update flag_exc = false;
143: 
144:             deposit storage += Some(x);
145:         }
146:     }
147: 
148:     /// Check that the 'reader' is actually a guard for the given object.
149:     property!{
150:         read_guard(x: V) {
151:             have reader >= {x};
152:             guard storage >= Some(x);
153:         }
154:     }
155: 
156:     property!{
157:         read_match(x: V, y: V) {
158:             have reader >= {x};
159:             have reader >= {y};
160:             assert(equal(x, y));
161:         }
162:     }
163: 
164:     /// Release the reader-lock. Decrement 'rc' and return the 'reader' object.
165:     #[transition]
166:     transition!{
167:         release_shared(x: V) {
168:             remove reader -= {x};
169: 
170:             assert(pre.flag_rc >= 1) by {
171:                 //assert(pre.reader.count(x) >= 1);
172:                 assert(equal(pre.storage, Option::Some(x)));
173:                 //assert(equal(x, pre.storage->0));
174:             };
175:             update flag_rc = (pre.flag_rc - 1) as nat;
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:     #[invariant]
180:     pub fn exc_bit_matches(&self) -> bool {
181:         (if self.flag_exc { 1 } else { 0 as int }) ==
182:             (if self.pending_writer is Some { 1 } else { 0 as int }) as int
183:             + (if self.writer is Some { 1 } else { 0 as int }) as int
184:     }
185: 
186:     #[invariant]
187:     pub fn count_matches(&self) -> bool {
188:         self.flag_rc == self.pending_reader.count(())
189:             + self.reader.count(self.storage->0)
190:     }
191: 
192:     #[invariant]
193:     pub fn reader_agrees_storage(&self) -> bool {
194:         forall |t: V| imply(#[trigger] self.reader.count(t) > 0,
195:             equal(self.storage, Option::Some(t)))
196:     }
197: 
198:     #[invariant]
199:     pub fn writer_agrees_storage(&self) -> bool {
200:         imply(self.writer is Some, self.storage is None)
201:     }
202: 
203:     #[invariant]
204:     pub fn writer_agrees_storage_rev(&self) -> bool {
205:         imply(self.storage is None, self.writer is Some)
206:     }
207: 
208:     #[invariant]
209:     pub fn sto_user_inv(&self) -> bool {
210:         self.storage.is_some() ==> Pred::inv(self.k, self.storage.unwrap())
211:     }
212: 
213:     #[inductive(acquire_read_start)]
214:     fn acquire_read_start_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
215:         broadcast use group_multiset_axioms;
216:     }
217: 
218:     #[inductive(acquire_read_end)]
219:     fn acquire_read_end_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
220:         broadcast use group_multiset_axioms;
221:     }
222: 
223:     #[inductive(acquire_read_abandon)]
224:     fn acquire_read_abandon_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
225:         broadcast use group_multiset_axioms;
226:     }
227: 
228:     #[inductive(acquire_exc_start)]
229:     fn acquire_exc_start_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) { }
230: 
231:     #[inductive(acquire_exc_end)]
232:     fn acquire_exc_end_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) { }
233: 
234:     #[inductive(release_exc)]
235:     fn release_exc_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, x: V) { }
236: 
237:     #[inductive(release_shared)]
238:     fn release_shared_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, x: V) {
239:         broadcast use group_multiset_axioms;
240:         assert(equal(pre.storage, Option::Some(x)));
241:     }
242: });

245: pub trait RwLockPredicate<V>: Sized {
246:     spec fn inv(self, v: V) -> bool;
247: }
248: 
249: impl<V> RwLockPredicate<V> for spec_fn(V) -> bool {
250:     open spec fn inv(self, v: V) -> bool {
251:         self(v)
252:     }
253: }
254: 
255: ghost struct InternalPred<V, Pred> {
256:     v: V,
257:     pred: Pred,
258: }
259: 
260: impl<V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> InvariantPredicate<Pred, V> for InternalPred<V, Pred> {
261:     closed spec fn inv(k: Pred, v: V) -> bool {
262:         k.inv(v)
263:     }
264: }
265: 
266: struct_with_invariants!{
267:     /** A verified implementation of a reader-writer lock,
268:     implemented using atomics and a reference count.
269: 
270:     When constructed, you can provide an invariant via the `Pred` parameter,
271:     specifying the allowed values that can go in the lock.
272: 
273:     Note that this specification does *not* verify the absence of dead-locks.
274: 
275:     ### Examples
276: 
277:     On construction of a lock, we can specify an invariant for the object that goes inside.
278:     One way to do this is by providing a `spec_fn`, which implements the [`RwLockPredicate`]
279:     trait.
280: 
281:     ```rust,ignore
282:     fn example1() {
283:         // We can create a lock with an invariant: `v == 5 || v == 13`.
284:         // Thus only 5 or 13 can be stored in the lock.
285:         let lock = RwLock::<u64, spec_fn(u64) -> bool>::new(5, Ghost(|v| v == 5 || v == 13));
286: 
287:         let (val, write_handle) = lock.acquire_write();
288:         assert(val == 5 || val == 13);
289:         write_handle.release_write(13);
290: 
291:         let read_handle1 = lock.acquire_read();
292:         let read_handle2 = lock.acquire_read();
293: 
294:         // We can take multiple read handles at the same time:
295: 
296:         let val1 = read_handle1.borrow();
297:         let val2 = read_handle2.borrow();
298: 
299:         // RwLock has a lemma that both read handles have the same value:
300: 
301:         proof { ReadHandle::lemma_readers_match(&read_handle1, &read_handle2); }
302:         assert(*val1 == *val2);
303: 
304:         read_handle1.release_read();
305:         read_handle2.release_read();
306:     }
307:     ```
308: 
309:     It's often easier to implement the [`RwLockPredicate`] trait yourself. This way you can
310:     have a configurable predicate without needing to work with higher-order functions.
311: 
312:     ```rust,ignore
313:     struct FixedParity {
314:         pub parity: int,
315:     }
316: 
317:     impl RwLockPredicate<u64> for FixedParity {
318:         open spec fn inv(self, v: u64) -> bool {
319:             v % 2 == self.parity
320:         }
321:     }
322: 
323:     fn example2() {
324:         // Create a lock that can only store even integers
325:         let lock_even = RwLock::<u64, FixedParity>::new(20, Ghost(FixedParity { parity: 0 }));
326: 
327:         // Create a lock that can only store odd integers
328:         let lock_odd = RwLock::<u64, FixedParity>::new(23, Ghost(FixedParity { parity: 1 }));
329: 
330:         let read_handle_even = lock_even.acquire_read();
331:         let val_even = *read_handle_even.borrow();
332:         assert(val_even % 2 == 0);
333: 
334:         let read_handle_odd = lock_odd.acquire_read();
335:         let val_odd = *read_handle_odd.borrow();
336:         assert(val_odd % 2 == 1);
337:     }
338:     ```
339:     */
340: 
341:     pub struct RwLock<V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> {
342:         exc: AtomicBool<_, RwLockToks::flag_exc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>, _>,
343:         rc: AtomicUsize<_, RwLockToks::flag_rc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>, _>,
344: 
345:         inst: Tracked<RwLockToks::Instance<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>>,
346:         pred: Ghost<Pred>,
347:     }
348: 
349:     #[verifier::type_invariant]
350:     spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
351:         invariant on exc with (inst) is (v: bool, g: RwLockToks::flag_exc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>) {
352:             g.instance_id() == inst@.id()
353:                 && g.value() == v
354:         }
355: 
356:         invariant on rc with (inst) is (v: usize, g: RwLockToks::flag_rc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>) {
357:             g.instance_id() == inst@.id()
358:                 && g.value() == v
359:         }
360: 
361:         predicate {
362:             self.inst@.k() == self.pred@
363:         }
364:     }
365: }
366: 
367: /// Handle obtained for an exclusive write-lock from an [`RwLock`].
368: ///
369: /// Note that this handle does not contain a reference to the lock-protected object;
370: /// ownership of the object is obtained separately from [`RwLock::acquire_write`].
371: /// This may be changed in the future.
372: ///
373: /// **Warning:** The lock is _NOT_ released automatically when the handle
374: /// is dropped. You must call [`release_write`](WriteHandle::release_write).
375: /// Verus does not check that lock is released.
376: pub struct WriteHandle<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> {
377:     tracked handle: Tracked<RwLockToks::writer<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>>,
378:     rwlock: &'a RwLock<V, Pred>,
379: }
380: 
381: /// Handle obtained for a shared read-lock from an [`RwLock`].
382: ///
383: /// **Warning:** The lock is _NOT_ released automatically when the handle
384: /// is dropped. You must call [`release_read`](ReadHandle::release_read).
385: /// Verus does not check that lock is released.
386: pub struct ReadHandle<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> {
387:     tracked handle: Tracked<RwLockToks::reader<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>>,
388:     rwlock: &'a RwLock<V, Pred>,
389: }
390: 
391: impl<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> WriteHandle<'a, V, Pred> {
392:     #[verifier::type_invariant]
393:     spec fn wf_write_handle(self) -> bool {
394:         equal(
395:             self.handle@.instance_id(),
396:             self.rwlock.inst@.id(),
397:         ) && self.rwlock.wf()
398:     }
399: 
400:     pub closed spec fn rwlock(self) -> RwLock<V, Pred> {
401:         *self.rwlock
402:     }
403: 
404:     pub fn release_write(self, Tracked(new_val): Tracked<V>)
405:         requires
406:             self.rwlock().inv(new_val),
407:     {
408:         proof {
409:             use_type_invariant(&self);
410:         }
411:         let WriteHandle { handle: Tracked(handle), rwlock } = self;
412: 
413:         atomic_with_ghost!(
414:             &rwlock.exc => store(false);
415:             ghost g =>
416:         {
417:             self.rwlock.inst.borrow().release_exc(new_val, &mut g, new_val, handle);
418:         });
419:     }
420: }
421: 
422: impl<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> ReadHandle<'a, V, Pred> {
423:     #[verifier::type_invariant]
424:     spec fn wf_read_handle(self) -> bool {
425:         equal(self.handle@.instance_id(), self.rwlock.inst@.id())
426:             && self.rwlock.wf()
427:     }
428: 
429:     pub closed spec fn view(self) -> V {
430:         self.handle@.element()
431:     }
432: 
433:     pub closed spec fn rwlock(self) -> RwLock<V, Pred> {
434:         *self.rwlock
435:     }
436: 
437:     /// Obtain a shared reference to the object contained in the lock.
438:     pub proof fn borrow<'b>(tracked &'b self) -> (tracked val: &'b V)
439:         ensures
440:             val == self.view(),
441:     {
442:         use_type_invariant(self);
443:         let tracked perm = self.rwlock.inst.borrow().read_guard(
444:             self.handle@.element(),
445:             self.handle.borrow(),
446:         );
447:         &perm
448:     }
449: 
450:     pub proof fn lemma_readers_match(
451:         tracked read_handle1: &ReadHandle<V, Pred>,
452:         tracked read_handle2: &ReadHandle<V, Pred>,
453:     )
454:         requires
455:             read_handle1.rwlock() == read_handle2.rwlock(),
456:         ensures
457:             (equal(read_handle1.view(), read_handle2.view())),
458:     {
459:         use_type_invariant(read_handle1);
460:         use_type_invariant(read_handle2);
461:         read_handle1.rwlock.inst.borrow().read_match(
462:             read_handle1.handle@.element(),
463:             read_handle2.handle@.element(),
464:             &read_handle1.handle.borrow(),
465:             &read_handle2.handle.borrow(),
466:         );
467:     }
468: 
469:     pub fn release_read(self) {
470:         proof { use_type_invariant(&self); }
471:         let ReadHandle { handle: Tracked(handle), rwlock } = self;
472: 
473:         let _ =
474:             atomic_with_ghost!(
475:             &rwlock.rc => fetch_sub(1);
476:             ghost g =>
477:         {
478:             rwlock.inst.borrow().release_shared(handle.element(), &mut g, handle);
479:         });
480:     }
481: }
482: 
483: impl<V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> RwLock<V, Pred> {
484:     /// Predicate configured for this lock instance.
485:     pub closed spec fn pred(&self) -> Pred {
486:         self.pred@
487:     }
488: 
489:     /// Indicates if the value `v` can be stored in the lock. Per the definition,
490:     /// it depends on `[self.pred()]`, which is configured upon lock construction ([`RwLock::new`]).
491:     pub open spec fn inv(&self, val: V) -> bool {
492:         self.pred().inv(val)
493:     }
494: 
495:     pub fn new(Tracked(val): Tracked<V>, Ghost(pred): Ghost<Pred>) -> (s: Self)
496:         requires
497:             pred.inv(val),
498:         ensures
499:             s.pred() == pred,
500:     {
501:         let tracked (Tracked(inst), Tracked(flag_exc), Tracked(flag_rc), _, _, _, _) =
502:             RwLockToks::Instance::<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>::initialize_full(pred, val, Some(val));
503:         let inst = Tracked(inst);
504: 
505:         let exc = AtomicBool::new(Ghost(inst), false, Tracked(flag_exc));
506:         let rc = AtomicUsize::new(Ghost(inst), 0, Tracked(flag_rc));
507: 
508:         RwLock { exc, rc, inst, pred: Ghost(pred) }
509:     }
510: 
511:     /// Acquires an exclusive write-lock. To release it, use [`WriteHandle::release_write`].
512:     ///
513:     /// **Warning:** The lock is _NOT_ released automatically when the handle
514:     /// is dropped. You must call [`WriteHandle::release_write`].
515:     /// Verus does not check that lock is released.
516:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
517:     pub fn acquire_write(&self) -> (ret: (Tracked<V>, WriteHandle<'_, V, Pred>))
518:         ensures
519:             ({
520:                 let val = *ret.0;
521:                 let write_handle = ret.1;
522:                 &&& write_handle.rwlock() == *self
523:                 &&& self.inv(val)
524:             }),
525:     {
526:         proof {
527:             use_type_invariant(self);
528:         }
529:         let mut done = false;
530:         let tracked mut token: Option<
531:             RwLockToks::pending_writer<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>,
532:         > = Option::None;
533:         while !done
534:             invariant
535:                 done ==> token.is_some() && equal(token->0.instance_id(), self.inst@.id()),
536:                 self.wf(),
537:         {
538:             let result =
539:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
540:                 &self.exc => compare_exchange(false, true);
541:                 returning res;
542:                 ghost g =>
543:             {
544:                 if res is Ok {
545:                     token = Option::Some(self.inst.borrow().acquire_exc_start(&mut g));
546:                 }
547:             });
548: 
549:             done =
550:             match result {
551:                 Result::Ok(_) => true,
552:                 _ => false,
553:             };
554:         }
555:         loop
556:             invariant
557:                 token is Some && equal(token->0.instance_id(), self.inst@.id()),
558:                 self.wf(),
559:         {
560:             let tracked mut perm_opt: Option<V> = None;
561:             let tracked mut handle_opt: Option<
562:                 RwLockToks::writer<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>,
563:             > = None;
564: 
565:             let result =
566:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
567:                 &self.rc => load();
568:                 returning res;
569:                 ghost g =>
570:             {
571:                 if res == 0 {
572:                     let tracked tok = match token { Option::Some(t) => t, Option::None => proof_from_false() };
573:                     let tracked x = self.inst.borrow().acquire_exc_end(&g, tok);
574:                     token = None;
575:                     let tracked (_, Tracked(perm), Tracked(exc_handle)) = x;
576:                     perm_opt = Some(perm);
577:                     handle_opt = Some(exc_handle);
578:                 }
579:             });
580: 
581:             if result == 0 {
582:                 let tracked mut perm = match perm_opt {
583:                     Option::Some(t) => t,
584:                     Option::None => proof_from_false(),
585:                 };
586:                 let tracked handle = match handle_opt {
587:                     Option::Some(t) => t,
588:                     Option::None => proof_from_false(),
589:                 };
590:                 let write_handle = WriteHandle {
591:                     handle: Tracked(handle),
592:                     rwlock: self,
593:                 };
594:                 return (Tracked(perm), write_handle);
595:             }
596:         }
597:     }
598: 
599:     /// Acquires a shared read-lock. To release it, use [`ReadHandle::release_read`].
600:     ///
601:     /// **Warning:** The lock is _NOT_ released automatically when the handle
602:     /// is dropped. You must call [`ReadHandle::release_read`].
603:     /// Verus does not check that lock is released.
604:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
605:     pub fn acquire_read(&self) -> (read_handle: ReadHandle<'_, V, Pred>)
606:         ensures
607:             read_handle.rwlock() == *self,
608:             self.inv(read_handle.view()),
609:     {
610:         proof {
611:             use_type_invariant(self);
612:         }
613:         loop
614:             invariant
615:                 self.wf(),
616:         {
617:             let val = atomic_with_ghost!(&self.rc => load(); ghost g => { });
618: 
619:             let tracked mut token: Option<
620:                 RwLockToks::pending_reader<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>,
621:             > = Option::None;
622: 
623:             if val < usize::MAX {
624:                 let result =
625:                     atomic_with_ghost!(
626:                     &self.rc => compare_exchange(val, val + 1);
627:                     returning res;
628:                     ghost g =>
629:                 {
630:                     if res is Ok {
631:                         token = Option::Some(self.inst.borrow().acquire_read_start(&mut g));
632:                     }
633:                 });
634: 
635:                 match result {
636:                     Result::Ok(_) => {
637:                         let tracked mut handle_opt:
